name: devlog-cms
description: Sends a finished timesheet to the Technology Partners consultant timesheet system (CMS): hours per assignment per day, on the assignment set on the task (or a canvas above it). Sending again only changes the days that differ from what CMS shows.

canvasFields.label: CMS assignment
canvasFields.description: The CMS assignment time on this canvas (and canvases inside it) goes to: its number, or its project name as CMS shows it. "List my CMS assignments" in the quick switcher shows them.

settings.label: CMS address
settings.description: Leave empty for the usual address.

secrets.label: CMS password
secrets.description: Used to log in each time Devlog sends hours; CMS has no tokens.
